passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Leave this place, you and the people you brought up out of the land of Egypt, and go to the land that I promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
Moses had led the people out of Egypt.
The LORD said, “Leave this place.
Take the people with you.
Go to the land I promised.
I made this promise to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
I said, ‘I will give this land to your descendants.’”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֙ לֵ֣ךְ עֲלֵ֣ה מִזֶּ֔ה אַתָּ֣ה וְהָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶֽעֱלִ֖יתָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֶל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֠שְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֨ם לְיִצְחָ֤ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹב֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְזַרְעֲךָ֖ אֶתְּנֶֽנָּה׃

passages.text: And I will send an angel before you, and I will drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses and the Israelites.
The LORD promised to send an angel ahead of them.
The angel will go before the people.
The LORD will drive out the Canaanites.
The LORD will drive out the Amorites.
The LORD will drive out the Hittites.
The LORD will drive out the Perizzites.
The LORD will drive out the Hivites.
The LORD will drive out the Jebusites.
passages.original: וְשָׁלַחְתִּ֥י לְפָנֶ֖יךָ מַלְאָ֑ךְ וְגֵֽרַשְׁתִּ֗י אֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י וְהַֽחִתִּי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י הַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃

passages.text: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people; otherwise, I might destroy you on the way.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses and the Israelites.
God promised to give them a land.
This land flows with milk and honey.
God told them to go up to this land.
God said, “I will not go with you.”
God called the Israelites a stiff-necked people.
God said, “If I go with you, I might destroy you on the way.”
passages.original: אֶל־ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָ֑שׁ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אֶֽעֱלֶ֜ה בְּקִרְבְּךָ֗ כִּ֤י עַם־ קְשֵׁה־ עֹ֙רֶף֙ אַ֔תָּה פֶּן־ אֲכֶלְךָ֖ בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃

passages.text: When the people heard these bad tidings, they went into mourning, and no one put on any of his jewelry.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites heard this bad news.
This news was that God would not go with them because they were stubborn.
The people mourned.
No one wore any jewelry.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע הָעָ֗ם אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הָרָ֛ע הַזֶּ֖ה וַיִּתְאַבָּ֑לוּ וְלֹא־ שָׁ֛תוּ אִ֥ישׁ עֶדְי֖וֹ עָלָֽיו׃

passages.text: For the LORD had said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I should go with you for a single moment, I would destroy you. Now take off your jewelry, and I will decide what to do with you.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a message for the Israelites.
The LORD said, “You are a stiff-necked people.
You are stubborn and resistant.
If I go with you for even a moment, I will destroy you.
Now take off your jewelry.
I will decide what to do with you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֱמֹ֤ר אֶל־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אַתֶּ֣ם עַם־ קְשֵׁה־ עֹ֔רֶף רֶ֧גַע אֶחָ֛ד אֶֽעֱלֶ֥ה בְקִרְבְּךָ֖ וְכִלִּיתִ֑יךָ וְעַתָּ֗ה הוֹרֵ֤ד עֶדְיְךָ֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יךָ וְאֵדְעָ֖ה מָ֥ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: So the Israelites stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites are God's chosen people.
The Israelites had sinned and received a warning from God.
God told the Israelites to remove their jewelry.
The Israelites obeyed God.
The Israelites took off their jewelry.
They removed their jewelry at Mount Horeb.
From Mount Horeb onward, the Israelites did not wear their jewelry.
passages.original: וַיִּֽתְנַצְּל֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ עֶדְיָ֖ם מֵהַ֥ר חוֹרֵֽב׃

passages.text: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it at a distance outside the camp. He called it the Tent of Meeting, and anyone inquiring of the LORD would go to the Tent of Meeting outside the camp.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses took a tent.
He set up the tent far outside the camp.
He called this tent the Tent of Meeting.
Anyone who wanted to seek the LORD would go out to the Tent of Meeting.
The Tent of Meeting was outside the camp.
passages.original: וּמֹשֶׁה֩ יִקַּ֨ח אֶת־ הָאֹ֜הֶל וְנָֽטָה־ ל֣וֹ׀ מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֗ה הַרְחֵק֙ מִן־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְקָ֥רָא ל֖וֹ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהָיָה֙ כָּל־ מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה יֵצֵא֙ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

passages.text: Then, whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people would stand at the entrances to their own tents and watch Moses until he entered the tent.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
He would go out to the Tent of Meeting.
Whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people would stand up.
Each person would stand at the entrance to his own tent.
They would watch Moses.
They watched him until he entered the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כְּצֵ֤את מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ הָאֹ֔הֶל יָק֙וּמוּ֙ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם וְנִ֨צְּב֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ פֶּ֣תַח אָהֳל֑וֹ וְהִבִּ֙יטוּ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַד־ בֹּא֖וֹ הָאֹֽהֱלָה׃

passages.text: As Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and remain at the entrance, and the LORD would speak with Moses.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses would enter the tent.
A pillar of cloud would come down.
The pillar of cloud would stand at the entrance of the tent.
The LORD would speak with Moses.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כְּבֹ֤א מֹשֶׁה֙ הָאֹ֔הֱלָה יֵרֵד֙ עַמּ֣וּד הֶֽעָנָ֔ן וְעָמַ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֑הֶל וְדִבֶּ֖ר עִם־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: When all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance to the tent, they would stand up and worship, each one at the entrance to his own tent.
passages.sermon:
All the people saw the pillar of cloud.
The pillar of cloud stood at the entrance to the tent.
Each person stood up.
Each person worshiped God.
Each person stood at the entrance to his own tent.
passages.original: וְרָאָ֤ה כָל־ הָעָם֙ אֶת־ עַמּ֣וּד הֶֽעָנָ֔ן עֹמֵ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֑הֶל וְקָ֤ם כָּל־ הָעָם֙ וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ פֶּ֥תַח אָהֳלֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Thus the LORD would speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. Then Moses would return to the camp, but his young assistant Joshua son of Nun would not leave the tent.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses face to face.
He spoke as a man speaks to his friend.
Afterward, Moses returned to the camp.
Joshua was Moses’ young assistant.
Joshua was the son of Nun.
Joshua did not leave the tent.
passages.original: וְדִבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֙ פָּנִ֣ים אֶל־ פָּנִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְדַבֵּ֥ר אִ֖ישׁ אֶל־ רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְשָׁב֙ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וּמְשָׁ֨רְת֜וֹ יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בִּן־ נוּן֙ נַ֔עַר לֹ֥א יָמִ֖ישׁ מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֹֽהֶל׃ס

passages.text: Then Moses said to the LORD, “Look, You have been telling me, ‘Lead this people up,’ but You have not let me know whom You will send with me. Yet You have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have found favor in My sight.’
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the LORD.
Moses said, “You have told me to lead this people.
You have not told me who will go with me.
You said, ‘I know you by name.’
You also said, ‘You have found favor in My sight.’”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֗ה רְ֠אֵה אַתָּ֞ה אֹמֵ֤ר אֵלַי֙ הַ֚עַל אֶת־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְאַתָּה֙ לֹ֣א הֽוֹדַעְתַּ֔נִי אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ תִּשְׁלַ֖ח עִמִּ֑י וְאַתָּ֤ה אָמַ֙רְתָּ֙ יְדַעְתִּ֣יךָֽ בְשֵׁ֔ם וְגַם־ מָצָ֥אתָ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינָֽי׃

passages.text: Now if indeed I have found favor in Your sight, please let me know Your ways, that I may know You and find favor in Your sight. Remember that this nation is Your people.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the LORD.
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses said, “If I have found favor in Your sight, please show me Your ways.
I want to know You.
I want to find favor in Your sight.
Remember, this nation is Your people.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה אִם־ נָא֩ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֜ן בְּעֵינֶ֗יךָ הוֹדִעֵ֤נִי נָא֙ אֶת־ דְּרָכֶ֔ךָ וְאֵדָ֣עֲךָ֔ לְמַ֥עַן אֶמְצָא־ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ וּרְאֵ֕ה כִּ֥י עַמְּךָ֖ הַגּ֥וֹי הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: And the LORD answered, “My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
passages.sermon: The LORD spoke to Moses.\r\nThe LORD said, "My Presence will go with you."\r\nThe LORD said, "I will give you rest."
passages.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר פָּנַ֥י יֵלֵ֖כוּ וַהֲנִחֹ֥תִי לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: “If Your Presence does not go with us,” Moses replied, “do not lead us up from here.
passages.sermon: Moses spoke to the LORD.\r\nMoses said, “If Your Presence does not go with us, do not lead us up from here.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑יו אִם־ אֵ֤ין פָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ הֹלְכִ֔ים אַֽל־ תַּעֲלֵ֖נוּ מִזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: For how then can it be known that Your people and I have found favor in Your sight, unless You go with us? How else will we be distinguished from all the other people on the face of the earth?”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the LORD.
Moses led the people of Israel.
Moses asked a question.
He said, “How will anyone know that I and Your people have found favor in Your sight?”
He said, “People will not know unless You go with us.”
He said, “If You go with us, then I and Your people will be different from all other people on the earth.”
passages.original: וּבַמֶּ֣ה׀ יִוָּדַ֣ע אֵפ֗וֹא כִּֽי־ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּעֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲנִ֣י וְעַמֶּ֔ךָ הֲל֖וֹא בְּלֶכְתְּךָ֣ עִמָּ֑נוּ וְנִפְלֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֲנִ֣י וְעַמְּךָ֔ מִכָּ֨ל־ הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃פ

passages.text: So the LORD said to Moses, “I will do this very thing you have asked, for you have found favor in My sight, and I know you by name.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said, “I will do what you have asked.”
You have found favor in My sight.
I know you by name.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה גַּ֣ם אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֑ה כִּֽי־ מָצָ֤אתָ חֵן֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י וָאֵדָעֲךָ֖ בְּשֵֽׁם׃

passages.text: Then Moses said, “Please show me Your glory.”
passages.sermon: Moses spoke to the LORD.\r\nMoses said, “Please show me Your glory.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַרְאֵ֥נִי נָ֖א אֶת־ כְּבֹדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: “I will cause all My goodness to pass before you,” the LORD replied, “and I will proclaim My name—the LORD—in your presence. I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said, “I will cause all My goodness to pass before you.
I will proclaim My name, the LORD, in your presence.
I will show mercy to whomever I choose.
I will show compassion to whomever I choose.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֲנִ֨י אַעֲבִ֤יר כָּל־ טוּבִי֙ עַל־ פָּנֶ֔יךָ וְקָרָ֧אתִֽי בְשֵׁ֛ם יְהוָ֖ה לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וְחַנֹּתִי֙ אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָחֹ֔ן וְרִחַמְתִּ֖י אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲרַחֵֽם׃

passages.text: But He added, “You cannot see My face, for no one can see Me and live.”
passages.sermon: The LORD spoke to Moses.\r\nThe LORD said, “You cannot see My face.”\r\nNo person can see My face and live.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לֹ֥א תוּכַ֖ל לִרְאֹ֣ת אֶת־ פָּנָ֑י כִּ֛י לֹֽא־ יִרְאַ֥נִי הָאָדָ֖ם וָחָֽי׃

passages.text: The LORD continued, “There is a place near Me where you are to stand upon a rock, and when My glory passes by, I will put you in a cleft of the rock and cover you with My hand until I have passed by.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD is holy and powerful.
The LORD said there is a place near Him.
The LORD told Moses to stand on a rock.
The LORD said His glory would pass by.
The LORD said He would put Moses in a cleft of the rock.
The LORD said He would cover Moses with His hand.
The LORD would do this until He had passed by.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֥ה מָק֖וֹם אִתִּ֑י וְנִצַּבְתָּ֖ עַל־ הַצּֽוּר׃ וְהָיָה֙ בַּעֲבֹ֣ר כְּבֹדִ֔י וְשַׂמְתִּ֖יךָ בְּנִקְרַ֣ת הַצּ֑וּר וְשַׂכֹּתִ֥י כַפִּ֛י עָלֶ֖יךָ עַד־ עָבְרִֽי׃

passages.text: Then I will take My hand away, and you will see My back; but My face must not be seen.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD is holy and powerful.
The LORD said, "I will remove My hand."
You will see My back.
You will not see My face.
No one can see My face and live.
passages.original: וַהֲסִרֹתִי֙ אֶת־ כַּפִּ֔י וְרָאִ֖יתָ אֶת־ אֲחֹרָ֑י וּפָנַ֖י לֹ֥א יֵרָאֽוּ׃ס
